Today we are shutting down the feature that 61% of our customers said was the reason they signed up.

It is the "AI summary" at the top of every company record. A green box with three sentences and a sparkle icon.

Usage after the first week of an account's life: 0.4% of sessions.

Support tickets that mention it: 218 since January. 190 of those are people asking how to turn it off because it covers the phone number.

We kept it for fourteen months because it demoed well. Our sales team told me this in August 2025. I told them the data would change once customers got used to it.

The data did not change. The sparkle icon is gone as of 9am. The phone number is now visible on load.
